d: A heavy, bipedal combat mech featuring a bulky, industrial build and a color palette of tan, dark grey, and black. The chassis is densely packed with weaponry, including a large gatling gun on the right shoulder, multiple missile pods on the back, and a heavy cannon integrated into the left arm. The head section is compact with small, glowing blue ocular sensors and orange warning lights, while the legs end in large, clawed mechanical feet. BODY COLOR: Tan and dark grey
